mapper.sql: id, username, password_hash, status, version, credentials_changed_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user ORDER BY id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT role.role_code FROM sys_user_role user_role INNER JOIN sys_role role ON role.id = user_role.role_id WHERE user_role.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY role.role_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user ( username, password_hash, status, version, credentials_changed_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{status}, 0, #{credentialsChangedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
INSERT INTO sys_user_role (user_id, role_id) SELECT #{userId}, id FROM sys_role WHERE role_code = #{roleCode}
